question: Should OpenClaw add bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-output-source boundary must they follow?
rationale: The feature is plausible and aligned with operator ergonomics, but it exposes operational logs and command output in a new always-available dashboard surface and depends on unresolved dashboard binding contracts.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Boundary Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate plus stream/command-output security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Allow a focused follow-up only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Builtins
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugins or missing plugin APIs until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard widgets.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Boundary Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate plus stream/command-output security model first, then implement widgets against approved contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the existing log-tail RPC and the bundled Control UI plugin-tab seam, both strongest in steipete's recent merged history.
